C1508.title: Teen's Digital Identity Sexually Assaulted in Metaverse Room
C1508.summary: UK police launch their first investigation into a virtual reality crime after a teenage girl's digital identity was sexually assaulted by multiple adult men and group gamblers in a metaverse virtual room.
